lines: 「Nasara! I'm counting on you to cover me!!!」
Clone Asagi was the first to rush out.
The multi-legged tank fired 7.62 mm rounds at the two of them, but
The tentacles that Nasara extended were weaving like whips, and catching all of the bullets.
No, it looked like she was eating them.
「Sorry! Once the job's over, I'll make you a tasty meal!」
Clone Asagi pointed both of her cyborg arms at the multi-legged tank.
And activated her “Nemesis” gravitational control unit.
A powerful gravitational field was generated, invisible to the eye.
Its state-of-the-art body started creaking, making an unpleasant sound.
Despite being destroyed by extreme gravitational force, the multi-legged tank was continuing to fire its machine gun.
But Nasara's tentacles were catching and absorbing everything.
Perhaps having recognized its insufficient firepower, the barrel of its main gun, a 12.7 mm heavy machine gun, jerkingly turned to face them.
It was a weapon that it would surely be prohibited from using indoors, let alone in a place where valuable materials were being stored.
「This is bad. I wonder if its AI went haywire when it was crushed? If it fires something like that―――」
It had power which, if hit head-on, would reduce even her cyborg body to pieces.
Although she was impassive about it, it looked like absorbing the gunfire of the 7.62 mm bullets was the most she could do.
Clone Asagi set Nemesis's output to full power.
She was going to crush it completely before they were shot at.
However, she was a step too late.
A 12.7 mm bullet was fired, clinically and emotionlessly.
Its firing mechanism was damaged, so it was just the one shot.
But that would be enough to destroy Clone Asagi.
Aki blocked the way, readying her large sword.
She still had her eyes blocked up from the tear gas bombs.
To her sides were Miriam's familiars, Shiro and Kuro.
「Be Aki's eyes and stop that high-speed disaster!!!」
「I can see it clearly!!! Mind's Eye!!! Slash the 12.7 mm bullet!!!!」
With her eyes still closed, Aki gave a flash of her sword.
A clear sound rang out, and the bullet was split right in half.
No matter if you were a Taimanin master swordsman, it would be impossible to slash a bullet being launched at an initial velocity of 887 metres per second.
About the only one who could do something so preposterous was Akiyama Rinko, who had the alias of “the Slasher”.
Which was why Aki had faced the enemy through the four eyes of Shiro and Kuro, via Miriam's magic.
The multi-legged tank was completely crushed, and fell silent.
And then, a little noise, and smoke.
「Oi, smoke's coming out of your arm!」
「It's just overheated. Looks like I'll have to service it, but I'll bill that as a necessary expense.」
It had been a victory for the detective team.
「Wooow, you made quite the spectacle out of that, didn't you?」
That astonished voice came from Mikoto.
She was carrying a huge amount of baggage in her arms, as though she were running away in the middle of the night.
「Well, more or less. I'd like to peruse a little longer, but I can't, can I?」
「Can't. Going home now. Want to eat... yummy meal...」
「Well, if Nasara-chan says she's going home, there's no choice, right?」
「Then, let's head back straight away. Our job is done now.」
「Eh? Wait a sec. Don't go and leave me on my own! I'm coming with yooouuu～～～」
Siren was lost for words in the underground factory.
When she had come running upon hearing the report of intruders, the security drones were all destroyed,
Cougar LAWS (her trusty, state-of-the-art, self-propelled, multi-legged tank) was crushed flat for some reason,
And, to top it all off, all sorts of precious Demon World goods had vanished entirely.
「Shiiit!!! What an infuriating city this is!!! After the thieves!!! After them!!!」
Siren ranted and raved at her subordinates.
Contrary to her inhuman appearance, her behaviour there was just like that of a short-tempered woman.
Having finished their job and made a tidy profit, the detective team had showed up at Shizuru's bar with triumphant faces.
「Oh, my. Sounds like the job went well, eh?♪」
「That's right, but...... I've also got repair costs for both my arms. Make it the fourth-most expensive.」
Kiryuu Mikoto generously said, having come into the bar dead last.
「Don't make such a surprised-looking face. You all worked hard for me today, so this is my treat. Order whatever you'd like.」
「All riiight!! Your most expensive drink! No, bring every one of them, from A to Z! Hurry, hurry!!」
「Yeah, good thinking! I'll forget about your insolence today! Prime rib steak, rare!」
「In that case, I suppose I'll have the Macallan 18 Year. On the rocks, please.」
Paying no attention whatsoever to the ruckus, Nasara was playing make-believe detective with Kuro.
It looked like they were treating the customer footprints left on the bar's carpet as some kind of evidence.
There was a group watching those cheerful sights from the back of the bar.
「That's Kiryuu Mikoto. Looks like she's with friends today.」
「Oi oi, Boss! Isn't that Igawa Asagi?!」
「No. A clone of her. The bastard spawn of Ryuumon.」
「I've heard rumours, but......... she's the spitting image of the original, huh?」
Yuri, Juubei and Kaworu were each making different expressions.
Just then, having heard a message from Shizuru, Kiryuu Mikoto approached them.
「Do you have some business with me?」
「I came to ask a favour of you.」
Yuri explained the situation to her.
Mikoto was listening like she wasn't particularly interested, but the second Yuri voiced the words “Evil Eye”, she discreetly began to make her eyes gleam.
「Could I ask you to treat me?」
「Hmmm. All right. But... I know. I have a condition...」
「Lately, a force calling themselves the Reverent Knights have built a secret factory in Yomihara―――」
「Hey, you! (Munch-munch.) You'd do well not to, (munch-munch), take on that girl's requests! (Gulp.)」
As soon as she began her shady dealings, all of a sudden, Miriam butted in.
Furthermore, still holding her platter of steak, with meat in her mouth.
「If you've got the money, I can counsel you, you know? I'm a detective.」
「Oi oi, things've gotten kinda interesting, eh?!」
「Hic. Outta booze, I'm ouuut! Bring me another rouuund! Hic!」
「You're one fine woman, y'know? How aboutcha let me buy you a drink?」
「Oh, my♪ I wonder if I should take you up on that offer?」
The bar was bustling and lively.
What these new encounters would bring about, no one knew.
